author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
What YEAR is this? When AM I? It can't be really be 26 years since my buddy brought home these black-boxed sets of Steam Powered robots from Gencon at a little booth for a pirate-themed company called Privateer Press. 

But it is. And now it's STEAMFORGED GAMES printing the original Steam-punk wargame, WARMACHINE. A new steer and a new direction. I've grabbed two starter sets, recruited the three most VARIED OG Warmachine gamers I can find, the passive aggressive know-it-all... the ticking time-bomb and the guy just glad to be here. And me; Mr Enthusiastic. We're going to take a fresh look at Warmachine Mk IV and run an escalation league using the Tales from the Frontlines publication and grow our humble starter sets into MIGHTY ARMIES. Check it out!

Tales from the Frontlines: https://steamforged.com/blogs/brands/warmachine-s-new-casual-play-pack-2026

The Warmachine APP, Free PDF Rulebook and Models: https://steamforged.com/collections/warmachine 

GMG is publicly supported. Become
title: A Tale of Four Journeymen - A Warmachine Mk IV League - Part 1
